raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Configuration 1 load sites on the face opposite the clamp",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 identifies only the opposite face. The unavailable initial-BVP image is Fig. 2(A), misreferenced as Fig. 1(A). Neither the number nor the in-face coordinates of load sites is stated. Coordinates below use the unit cube [0,1]^3, clamped at x=0.",
      "readings": [
        "One site at the face center, (1,1/2,1/2).",
        "One site at an edge midpoint, (1,1/2,0).",
        "One off-center site at (1,1/2,1/4).",
        "Two sites at (1,1/2,1/4) and (1,1/2,3/4)."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Configuration 1 load footprint and spatial weighting",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 and the Fig. 2 caption do not specify concentrated versus distributed loading, footprint dimensions, traction profile, or relative weights if there are multiple load sites.",
      "readings": [
        "A concentrated force applied at one grid node.",
        "A uniform line load along one complete edge of the opposite face.",
        "Uniform traction over a square patch of side 2/64.",
        "Uniform traction over the entire opposite face.",
        "Two concentrated forces with equal magnitudes.",
        "Two concentrated forces with magnitudes in a 2:1 ratio."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Configuration 1 force or traction directions",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 refers to the initial-BVP figure without providing direction vectors. The terms 'symmetric' and 'non-symmetric' do not identify the direction pattern of configuration 1.",
      "readings": [
        "Tangential loading parallel to -z.",
        "Normal loading parallel to +x.",
        "Oblique loading parallel to (1,0,-1).",
        "Oppositely directed tangential forces at paired sites."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Overall amplitude of the configuration 1 load pattern",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither Sec. 4.1 nor the Fig. 2 caption gives an applied-force or traction magnitude. This item concerns a common multiplier with positions, directions, and relative weights held fixed.",
      "readings": [
        "Reference force magnitude 1 in consistent solver units.",
        "Reference force magnitude 10 in the same units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Protected solid material at clamp and load attachments",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 specifies no non-design solid regions. Algorithm 1 thresholds all voxels but gives no explicit mask or attachment-preservation rule.",
      "readings": [
        "No protected solid voxels; every voxel is eligible for removal.",
        "Protect one voxel layer at the clamped face and the voxels directly carrying loads.",
        "Protect two voxel layers at the clamp and one-voxel-thick 3-by-3-cell pads around load sites."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Topological-derivative removal threshold C",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 2.3 and 5 identify C as the implicit regularization and detail-control parameter. Only the typical range 0.001–0.1 is supplied; the configuration 1 value is absent.",
      "readings": [
        "Constant C=0.001.",
        "Constant C=0.01.",
        "Constant C=0.1."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Isolation and connectivity cleanup during optimization",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2.3 says post-processing excludes 'isolated voxels' without defining adjacency, component size, or whether disconnected multi-voxel components are removed.",
      "readings": [
        "Remove only individual voxels having no solid face neighbor, using 6-neighbor adjacency.",
        "Remove only individual voxels having no solid face, edge, or corner neighbor, using 26-neighbor adjacency.",
        "Remove every solid component not connected to the clamped face."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Surface-irregularity cleanup during optimization",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2.3 includes removal of 'surface irregularities' before volume and cost evaluation, but specifies no operation, stencil, feature-size criterion, or number of passes.",
      "readings": [
        "Delete only exposed single-voxel protrusions.",
        "Apply one binary morphological-opening pass with a radius-one 6-neighbor structuring element.",
        "Apply one binary morphological-opening pass with a 3-by-3-by-3 structuring element."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Laplacian smoothing of the configuration 1 final surface",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 and Fig. 2(C) specify final Laplacian smoothing, but omit weights, relaxation, iteration count, attachment constraints, and volume preservation. These are needed to reproduce the smoothed geometry.",
      "readings": [
        "One uniform-neighbor Laplacian pass with relaxation 0.1, attachment vertices fixed, and no volume correction.",
        "Ten uniform-neighbor passes with relaxation 0.5, attachment vertices fixed, and no volume correction.",
        "Ten cotangent-weighted passes with relaxation 0.1, attachment vertices fixed, and volume preservation."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Elasticity-solve convergence accuracy for configuration 1",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3 assigns GMRES tolerance 10^-4 to the separate uniform-tension benchmark. Sec. 4.1 reports 100–200 iterations without specifying its tolerance or residual convention, so carrying over that benchmark setting is uncertain.",
      "readings": [
        "Use a relative residual tolerance of 10^-4.",
        "Use an absolute residual tolerance of 10^-4.",
        "Use a separately selected relative residual tolerance of 10^-6."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
